dedupe_keys.name: croatia unified plan for mobile and broadcast antenna masts uredba 2025 planned free standing masts and electronic communication zones hakom

description: Croatia plans new free-standing antenna masts centrally: a government regulation adopts a unified plan for the development of mobile network infrastructure and a plan for broadcast network infrastructure, which spatial plans must then accommodate. The Croatian Regulatory Authority for Network Industries publishes the 2025 regulation's plan as an ArcGIS feature service with four layers. Two point layers hold the planned free-standing masts, 1,541 for mobile networks and 312 for broadcasting, each with an identifier, national grid coordinates (HTRS96), county, municipality or city, and settlement. Two polygon layers hold the electronic communication zones within which each mast may be placed. The previous draft, put to public consultation in 2022, is published alongside as a separate service. Coverage: Croatia. Format and access: ArcGIS REST feature service (JSON, GeoJSON), free; no licence was stated. Caveats: these are planned locations and search zones, not built sites; the service does not say which masts have been built or which operators will share them. Simulation uses: future mobile and broadcast mast locations for coverage expansion and hazard exposure scenarios, and shared-infrastructure planning studies. Related records: the HAKOM transmitter list gives existing transmitters; the MODA remote and mountain mobile coverage programmes for Taiwan and the KCA mountain mobile base stations for South Korea give comparable planned or subsidised site lists.
